data.title: Granite + Obsidian — A steady audience for complicated feelings
data.text:
Verdict: HARMONIOUS
Explanation: Granite's patient presence gives Obsidian room to speak without defending its intensity. Obsidian notices affection hidden beneath Granite's practical manner.
Household agreement: Use direct reassurance and private conversations rather than guessing at silence.
Avoid: No public jokes about sensitivity or emotional overengineering.
Bureau note: Granite listened to all three acts of the problem and did not ask when the interval was.

data.title: Basalt + Granite — The neighborhood watch that remembers birthdays
data.text:
Verdict: HARMONIOUS
Explanation: Basalt supplies initiative and Granite supplies patience. Their shared love of routines makes affection look like a carefully maintained timetable.
Household agreement: Give them one shared ritual and some unstructured time without an agenda.
Avoid: Do not let sensible planning consume every playful activity.
Bureau note: They once prepared a fire drill for a birthday candle, then baked the birthday an apology.

data.title: Granite + Marble — The patron and the publicity department
data.text:
Verdict: CONDITIONAL
Explanation: Granite's dependable affection suits Marble, but its restrained delivery may look like indifference unless spoken aloud.
Household agreement: Agree on modest, regular appreciation rituals and protected quiet time.
Avoid: Do not use extravagant gifts as a substitute for clear attention.
Bureau note: Granite's annual review said excellent companion. Marble requested it be read with orchestral backing.

data.title: Granite + Limestone — The dependable Sunday dinner
data.text:
Verdict: HARMONIOUS
Explanation: Both appreciate continuity and patient company. Limestone brings stories; Granite makes it safe to tell the same favorite story again.
Household agreement: Keep familiar rituals while inviting one small new experience at a time.
Avoid: Do not let nostalgia become a ban on every change.
Bureau note: Their family recipe includes one cup of patience and a sedimentary amount of gravy.

data.title: Granite + Slate — Order without constant supervision
data.text:
Verdict: HARMONIOUS
Explanation: Granite likes agreements and Slate likes clear boundaries. Both can enjoy steady companionship without filling every silence.
Household agreement: Write down shared expectations and keep a private shelf for each.
Avoid: Do not transform their tidy household into a competitive inspection.
Bureau note: Visitors describe the atmosphere as a library that remembers to offer tea.

data.title: Granite + Sandstone — Roots and a borrowed suitcase
data.text:
Verdict: CONDITIONAL
Explanation: Granite enjoys a stable base; Sandstone enjoys returning to one. They struggle only when permanence is interpreted as never going anywhere.
Household agreement: Keep a familiar home corner and agree on room for short adventures.
Avoid: Do not turn every departure into a referendum on loyalty.
Bureau note: Granite secretly keeps every postcard, filed by how much it missed the sender.

data.title: Granite + Pumice — The agenda acquires stickers
data.text:
Verdict: CONDITIONAL
Explanation: Pumice helps Granite try new things; Granite offers a dependable landing place. Pace differences need accommodation rather than blame.
Household agreement: Alternate a predictable shared activity with a brief playful one.
Avoid: Do not schedule an entire day of compulsory stillness or compulsory excitement.
Bureau note: Pumice added a standing item called pleasant nonsense to the household agenda.

data.title: Gneiss + Granite — The plan and its tasteful variations
data.text:
Verdict: HARMONIOUS
Explanation: They respect each other's complexity. Granite grounds shared projects while Gneiss prevents every decision becoming permanent policy.
Household agreement: Let one plan the essentials and the other suggest reversible experiments.
Avoid: Do not label every new idea a breach of tradition.
Bureau note: Their book club includes books, discussion and one unexplained stripe-themed intermission.
